alphas.name: Cash Flow Accrual Quality + VWAP Disparity Composite
alphas.expression: 0.4 * (group_zscore(cashflow_op / cap, subindustry) - group_zscore((income - cashflow_op) / cap, subindustry)) - 0.8 * group_zscore(ts_decay_linear((close - vwap) / (high - low + 0.001 * close), 2), subindustry) * group_rank(volume / adv20, subindustry)

alphas.name: DuPont Efficiency (Operating ROA + Sales Turnover) + 5-Day MA Timing
alphas.expression: 0.3 * (group_zscore(ebitda / assets, subindustry) + group_zscore(sales / assets, subindustry)) - 0.9 * group_zscore(ts_decay_linear(ts_av_diff(close, 5) / (close * ts_std_dev(returns, 20)), 2), subindustry) * group_rank(volume / adv20, subindustry)

alphas.name: Composite Value (Book-to-Price + EBITDA Yield) + 3-Day Candlestick Body Reversal
alphas.expression: 0.35 * (group_zscore(bookvalue_ps / close, subindustry) + group_zscore(ebitda / cap, subindustry)) - 0.85 * group_zscore(ts_decay_linear((close - open) / (high - low + 0.001 * vwap), 3), subindustry) * group_rank(volume / adv20, subindustry)

alphas.name: Quality Solvency Anchor (Cash Yield + Operating ROA) + 5-Day VWAP Deviation Timing
alphas.expression: 0.35 * (group_zscore(cash / cap, subindustry) + group_zscore(operating_income / assets, subindustry)) - 0.85 * group_zscore(ts_decay_linear((close - ts_decay_linear(vwap, 5)) / (close * ts_std_dev(returns, 20)), 2), subindustry) * group_rank(volume / adv20, subindustry)
